Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

The policy of joining on immediate absorption basis will also apply to employees of one Public Sector Undertaking joining another Public Exemptions from the principle of immediate absorption in Central Public Enterprise  
Sector Undertaking, regardless of the level of posts involved. will have to be obtained from the Department of Public Enterprises.  
- BPE OM, dated 6-3-1985 and Dept. of P. & P.W., OM, dated 25-4-2005.
